title: wg: protocol-06 §3.3 hub check on keyMaterial undefined
description: Suggestion. §3.3 has the hub relay keyMaterial for hosted rooms but never states what the hub must check about the requester. mimid requires a participant with canAddParticipant (decision mimid-1wgh.6.20).
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED, relocate: normative gap is §5.2 (no MUST to verify requesterCredential/authorize); §3.3 walkthrough puts check at follower. canAddParticipant is mimid's choice, offer as option. New issue citing #110.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/151
